periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 60 degrees downward-sloping relative to the horizontal facial midline, converging toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval, with vertical elongation roughly double the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward expansion with the center of mass located below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High, dark pixels occupy nearly half of the upper vertical torso region in this orientation.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separated by a distance roughly equivalent to the width of one pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and rounded at the superior boundary.
